evidence.title: Lecithin in AF-12?
evidence.claim: In 2016, QC staff were unaware of the specific purpose or documentation justifying the use of soy lecithin in AF-12.
evidence.quote: No idea. I have never seen a document about it. I would not remove it without a trial batch.

evidence.title: FATTURA / INVOICE n. 2456/24

evidence.title: Verbale riunione di produzione - 10 marzo 1997
evidence.claim: In 1997, the use of lecithin in AF-12 was attributed to a 1984 specification by Ing. Corradi, though the original document was missing.
evidence.quote: Lecitina in AF-12: nessuno trova la scheda originale dell'Ing. Corradi (1984). Bellone ricorda che "si è sempre messa".
